name: Mistral Chat
creator: Mike Anderson
description: Chat with Mistral models through Mistral's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. mistral-medium-latest is the balanced default; mistral-large-latest for quality, mistral-small-latest for economy, codestral-latest for code, magistral-medium-latest for reasoning. The -latest aliases track Mistral's current release of each family.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt to set the AI's behaviour and context

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (e.g. 0 for deterministic extraction); provider default when omitted

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p; provider default when omitted
